lane: Mobile + content: Nilaza reading v1 five-layer library (value report batch B, Owner approved 21/11)
goal: The free Tarot reading is composed from a five-layer library (card meaning by topic, position voice, card combinations, spread guide, small step and journal question) instead of one keyword sentence per card, so a free reading of one question reads differently from another, offline and without an AI call.
successCriteria: A bundled data file packages/content/data/tarot-reading-layers.json holds position roles for all five spreads, position voice (upright and reversed), combination rules, a reading guide per spread, a small step and journal question per topic and dominant energy, and reversed-per-topic meanings for six sample cards, all in Vietnamese and English.

The summary names the question or topic, the overall energy, any element tension or harmony, court cards, aces or repeated numbers, and how to read this spread; it never predicts a certain outcome or reads another person's mind.

Each card body opens with its position voice and then the card meaning for the chosen topic (upright from the Owner-approved card guide; reversed from the sample when present, otherwise the general reversed meaning).
The reading carries one 'small step in the next 24 hours' section and a journal question chosen by topic and dominant energy.
validate:data checks the new file for VI/EN completeness, valid card ids and spread roles matching the app spreads.
Readings saved before this change still display as before.
untouchedSurfaces: Edge Functions, prompts, model routes, quotas and migrations are unchanged (AI-side use of the library is batch C).
The 78 card meanings in tarot-cards.json and the Owner-approved tarot-card-guide.json are read, not edited.
Admin content publishing of the layers is not added yet; the file ships bundled in the app.
Guest flow, paywall, Nil and lock rules are unchanged.

impact.entryPoint: Tarot result screen after a free draw (server draw without AI, or local fallback when the AI fails).
impact.dataWrite: New readings save a longer summary, per-card interpretation text and one extra section; the reading shape and storage keys stay the same.
impact.backendContract: No API change; the server draw and AI retry paths are unchanged.
impact.adminVisibility: No Admin screen change; the workflow catalog digest for App.tsx is refreshed.
impact.privacySafety: All text is local and reflective: no certain predictions, no mind-reading of the other person, no healing or ritual claims; nothing new is sent off the device.
impact.observability: No new events; the existing feedback report still lists the summary and sections.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; saved readings keep the text they were created with.

canonicalContracts: packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json stays the only card-meaning source; the layers file only frames it
packages/content/data/tarot-card-guide.json stays the upright per-topic meaning source
apps/mobile/src/features/tarot/localReading.ts is the only composer of the free reading text
